fields.description:
Summary

Direct deals now have multiple sources, so two BetMGM-Direct-ON deals can differ only by source — the current name format can't tell them apart in list views. Solution: the Deal Name flow appends -{Source_Code__c} after Vertical (all deals, only when Source is set), keeping -TEST as the final token — e.g. ON-BETMGM-DIRECT-CASINO-S. Extends the format from BUILD-117/BUILD-125.

Current state

Flow Deal_Before_Save_Set_Deal_Name sets Name via formula DealNameFormat: {Market_State_Code_c|country}{Operator Name}{Partner_Codec}-{Vertical} uppercased, then -TEST if Test_Deal_c. Example: ON-BETMGM-GD-CASINO. Fires on create and update with no entry filter → Name restamps whenever deal makeup changes (decided behavior; CMS keys on External Deal ID, not Name).

Proposed solution

  1. Modify DealNameFormat to append -{Source_Code_c} (from BUILD-246) after Vertical, only when Source_Code_c is non-blank, keeping TEST as the final token: {geo}{OPERATOR}{PARTNER_CODE}{VERTICAL}[-{S}][-TEST]

  2. "Direct" remains spelled out in full (explicit Aug 25 decision — no -D shortening).

Acceptance criteria

  1. Existing before-save trigger on create/update; no new trigger.

  2. Deal with Source=Shurzy → name ends -S; suffix applies to all deals (any partner), not only Direct.

  3. Source blank → name identical to today's format, no trailing hyphen.

  4. Test deal with Source → …-S-TEST, not …-TEST-S.

  5. Re-saving an unchanged Deal produces the same Name (idempotent).

Out of scope

  • External Deal ID (BUILD-247).

  • Requiring Source (BUILD-249).
fields.summary: BUILD-248 — Deal: Append Source code to Deal Name automation

comments.body:
Updated Formula in this flow: Deal - After Save - Set Deal Name https://nosoftware-nosoftware-7430--partialsb.sandbox.lightning.force.com/builder_platform_interaction/flowBuilder.app?flowId=301WJ000011YdkIYAS

UPPER(

BLANKVALUE(

IF( LEN({!$Record.Market_State_Code__c}) > 0,

{!$Record.Market_State_Code__c},

IF( {!$Record.Market_Country_Code__c} = 'US & CA', 'USCA',

{!$Record.Market_Country_Code__c} )

), 'NOMKT')

& '-' & BLANKVALUE({!$Record.Operator__r.Name}, 'NOOP')

& '-' & BLANKVALUE({!$Record.Partner_r.Partner_Code_c}, 'NOPT')

& '-' & TEXT({!$Record.Vertical__c})

)

& IF( LEN({

$Record.Source_Code__c}, '' )

& IF( {!$Record.Test_Deal__c}, '-TEST', '' )

  • Formula above also makes some improvements on handling blank values for operator/partner,etc. and renamed the flow to After Save as it was previously named Before Save incorrectly.

Heads-up on the Source_Code__c reference (2026-09-08)

The formula in this ticket references {!$Record.Source_Code__c}, which is safe as written — Deal_Before_Save_Set_Deal_Name is actually an after-save flow despite its "Before Save" label, and after-save flows read recalculated formula fields fine.

It becomes a silent defect if that flow is ever converted to before-save (the mislabelled trigger type is worth its own clone-and-rebuild ticket). Before-save flows cannot read same-record formula fields — on insert the value is blank, on update it is the pre-update value. If the conversion happens, replace the reference with an in-flow CASE, mirroring fxSourceCode in the External Deal ID flow but without its NOSRC fallback (the placeholder belongs in the id, not the Name). Otherwise every new deal name silently loses its Source suffix.

Related: BUILD-272 — Deal: Makeup dedupe key and duplicate block, which extends that External Deal ID flow.
